name: Kasaya
_about: the kasaya: a Buddha's upper robe as it is carved (2026-11-04, the Yunding Temple's Buddhas): the himation's cut over the left shoulder, the right bare, but ending at the waist -- the under-robe (trousers) carved round the crossed legs -- so it lies on the shoulder and the upper arm as a short fall, where the himation, down to the calves, stood a pleated wall off the hanging arm beside a seated figure
